display.wifiQrAlt: QR code for the guest Wi-Fi

markup.title: Emphasizing text
markup.note: Applies to the texts of these fields. Color, font and size of the highlight are set under “Layout” in the row “Highlighted text” (default: accent color). The marks can be combined. Write a literal asterisk or tilde as \* or \~.

login.title: Sign in
login.hint: The admin token is set in the ADMIN_TOKEN environment variable or printed to the container log on first start.

visits.companyOnlyHint: Only the company is shown – without employees.
visits.orderHint: Change the order by drag and drop or with the arrows (default: alphabetical).
visits.showAvatarsHint: Default: off – only names (and positions) are shown.
visits.title: Visits
visits.intro: Who is coming when? On the day of the visit the screen automatically welcomes the company and its employees.
visits.messagePlaceholder: e.g. “Project number 4711 · Your meeting takes place in conference room Rhine.”
visits.noEmployeesForCompany: There are no employees on file for this company yet.
visits.selectEmployee: Please select at least one employee – or choose “No employees”.
visits.headline: Headline

companies.initialsColor: Own background color for the initials
companies.title: Companies
companies.intro: Visiting companies with their logo and employees.
companies.name: Name
companies.logoHint: PNG/SVG with a transparent background works best.
companies.deleteWhat: company “{name}” including all employees and visits

avatars.imageRequired: Please upload a picture or enter an image URL.
avatars.title: Picture pool for employees
avatars.intro: Default pictures that can be chosen for any employee instead of an own photo. Without a picture the initials are shown.
avatars.name: Name
avatars.deleteWhat: picture “{name}” (employees using it show their initials again)
avatars.none: No pictures in the pool yet.

layouts.backgroundVideoHint: MP4 (H.264) or WebM, max. 60 MB. Plays muted in a loop and fills the screen. The background image stays as the fallback: it is shown until the video has loaded and on devices opened with “?video=0”.
layouts.activeHint: This is the layout the screen shows right now. Changes are visible as soon as they are saved.
layouts.otherHint: Choose a layout to adjust and preview it – the active layout stays untouched until you click “Activate” here.
layouts.noOther: There is no other layout yet. Copy the active layout (“Copy layout” on the left) or create a new one here.
layouts.nameHint: To rename, change the name and save – also for the active layout.
layouts.copyHint: Creates a copy of the saved layout with all its settings and images.
layouts.copied: Copy “{name}” created – you can change its name at the top.
layouts.companyLogoSizeHint: Logo of the visiting company in the visit tiles.
layouts.footerGap: Gap to the navigation at the bottom
layouts.gapHint: Pixels at Full HD, scaled with the screen size.
layouts.footerGapHint: The content is scaled down if necessary, so it never lies under the navigation.
layouts.typography: Fonts, sizes and colors of the texts
layouts.typographyHint: Empty fields use the default. Size in percent of the default size. Shipped fonts are in the list; other names work if the font is installed on the display device.

sizeHint.highlight: size relative to the surrounding text; default color: accent color

layouts.title: Layout
layouts.intro: Appearance of the welcome screen. Several layouts are possible (e.g. seasonal) – the active one is shown.
layouts.heading: Layout “{name}”
layouts.name: Name

templates.glass: Centered glass card (background image, logo top left, time top right)

layouts.backgroundHint: Landscape, ideally 1920×1080 or 3840×2160 (max. 8 MB). Without an image a gradient is used.
layouts.logoHint: Your own company logo – a light version with a transparent background works best.
layouts.dimHint: Darkens with light text, brightens with dark text.
layouts.noBackground: Without a background image the gradient is dark – light text works.
layouts.contrast: Contrast with the background image: {ratio} : 1 – {verdict} (the glass effect improves this a little).

settings.title: Settings
settings.weatherIntro: Weather data from Open-Meteo (free, no API key). Without coordinates no weather is shown.
settings.searchPlaceholder: Search for a place, e.g. Berlin
settings.noSsid: Without an SSID the Wi-Fi tab is hidden.
settings.defaultTextHint: Leave empty to use the default of the selected language.
settings.apiText: REST API at {api}, MCP server (Streamable HTTP) at {mcp}. Write access and MCP require the admin token as a bearer token.

settings.site_name: Your company name (for the greeting when no visit is scheduled)
settings.idle_title: Headline when no visit is scheduled today
settings.idle_text: Text when no visit is scheduled today

errors.videoTooLarge: The video is too large (max. {max} MB).
errors.unknownVideoType: Unknown video format. Allowed: MP4 (H.264) and WebM.
errors.videoUrlStatus: Video at {url} could not be loaded (HTTP {status}).
errors.imageUrlStatus: Image at {url} could not be loaded (HTTP {status}).
errors.avatarNotFound: Picture “{ref}” not found in the pool.
errors.fontName: {field}: the font name may only contain letters, digits, spaces, dots, hyphens and underscores.
errors.nonexistentDate: Invalid {field} “{value}” – this day does not exist.
errors.endBeforeStart: The end date is before the start date.
errors.employeeExists: Employee “{name}” already exists in this company.
errors.employeeOtherCompany: Employee {ref} does not belong to this company.
errors.employeeAmbiguous: The name “{ref}” is ambiguous – please specify the company or the ID.
errors.activeLayoutDelete: The active layout cannot be deleted – activate another one first.
errors.color: {field} must be given in the format #RRGGBB.
errors.imageTooLarge: The image is too large (max. {max} MB).
errors.unknownImageType: Unknown image format. Allowed: PNG, JPEG, GIF, WEBP, SVG.
errors.geocodeTooShort: Please enter at least 2 characters to search for a place.
errors.unauthorized: Not authorized. Send the admin token as “Authorization: Bearer <token>”.
